# Font test fixtures

- `RobotoFlex-Variable.woff2`: Google Fonts Roboto Flex v30, Latin variable-weight subset, downloaded from the CSS2 API on 2026-10-29. License: RobotoFlex-OFL.txt.
- `Inter-Regular.woff2`: full regular font from https://github.com/rsms/inter/blob/master/docs/font-files/Inter-Regular.woff2, downloaded on 2026-10-29. License: Inter-LICENSE.txt. The full font preserves the `zero` feature used by the WOFF2 baking test.

These are real WOFF2 inputs; tests verify their signatures and exercise the committed production WASM artifact.
